introduction: LawHelpMN helps people find Minnesota legal information, clinics and legal aid referrals. Its guide asks questions to suggest suitable resources.
description: LawHelpMN helps people find Minnesota legal information, clinics and legal aid referrals. Its guide asks questions to suggest suitable resources.

sections.who: Anyone can use the information library. Legal aid providers separately decide eligibility and whether they can accept a case.
sections.get: The site offers self-help information and connections to free or low-cost legal options. It does not guarantee representation.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Use the guide

    Visit LawHelpMN and answer the referral questions.

  2. Find providers

    Search Providers and Clinics by legal topic and service area.

  3. Contact intake

    Explain deadlines and ask what records the organization needs.
sections.after: Continue observing court deadlines until a lawyer explicitly accepts the case.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using LawHelpMN site guidance; Provider directory. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: The provider directory filters service areas.
The site includes Spanish, Hmong and Somali.
Does a referral guarantee a lawyer?
No. The provider screens the case.
